from base_sensor import BaseVirtualSensor

class TMP117_Simulator(BaseVirtualSensor):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.regs = {
            0x00: 0x8000,  # TEMP
            0x01: 0x0220,  # CONFIG
            0x02: 0x6000,  # THIGH
            0x03: 0x8000,  # TLOW
            0x04: 0x0000,  # EEPROM_UL
            0x05: 0x0000,  # EEPROM1
            0x06: 0x0000,  # EEPROM2
            0x07: 0x0000,  # TEMP_OFFSET
            0x08: 0x0000,  # EEPROM3
            0x0F: 0x0117   # DEVICE_ID
        }

    def read_register(self, addr: int, nbytes: int = 2) -> int:
        if nbytes == 2:
            return self.regs[addr]
        elif nbytes == 1:
            return (self.regs[addr] & 0xFF00) >> 8

    def write_register(self, addr: int, data: int, nbytes: int = 2) -> None:
        if nbytes == 2:
            self.regs[addr] = data
        elif nbytes == 1:
            self.regs[addr] = (self.regs[addr] & 0x00FF) | (data << 8)

        # Handle special cases
        if addr == 0x01:  # CONFIG
            if (data & 0x8000) != 0x8000:  # SOFT_RESET
                self.regs[addr] = 0x0220  # reset value
            if (data & 0x4000) != 0x4000:  # DR_ALERT
                self.regs[addr] = (self.regs[addr] & 0x3FFF)  # reset value
        elif addr == 0x07:  # TEMP_OFFSET
            self.regs[addr] = data  # no read_as
